name: block-secret-store-reads
description: Best-effort guard against an agent reading credentials from the shell: cat, cp, tar, source or < on ~/.ssh (not .pub), ~/.aws, ~/.npmrc, agent CLI dirs, browser DBs, wallets, .env, *.tfstate; interpreter one-liners naming them; token printers (gh auth token, aws sts); curl, wget or iwr to cloud metadata credential paths (169.254.169.254, 169.254.170.2, GCE). Asks on env dumps. Misses: scripts, unresolved variables, xargs lists, $(...) results, metadata reached by DNS name, proxy or SDK. [Session-enforced in Codex by a PreToolUse hook: a matched command is denied before it runs (witnessed blocking on Codex Desktop, Windows, 2026-08-24; the deny is returned as hook JSON, not an exit code, which Codex's Windows shell wrapper mangles). Codex requires a one-time trust review per hook -- the plugin is ADVISORY until you approve its hook, and a plugin update voids that trust until re-approved. The hook needs git and a Python 3.11+ (python3, python or py) on PATH; with no working Python it exits 2 rather than allowing, and any other failure of the HOOK (missing git, a timeout, an unexpected exit) fails OPEN. A failure of the GUARD it runs is a DENY here, because Codex rejects the confirmation prompt the other clients get. Repo-wide enforcement at commit time and in CI still needs `chock sync`.]
